title: Avatar model manifest
description: manifest.json at the root of a packaged avatar model. Clip data lives in the metadata file; the state machine lives in the fsm file.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Treated as 1 when omitted.

name.description: URL-safe model name. Used in URL paths (/video/<name>/...), so no spaces or dots.

version.description: Optional semantic version of the model.

clipDir.description: Directory inside the package that holds the fragmented clips. package_model.py sets this to 'clip'.

fsm.description: File name of the FSM JSON, at the package root.

metadata.description: File name of the clip metadata JSON, at the package root.

thumbnail.description: File name of the thumbnail image, at the package root.
